semantic_comparisons.proposed_distinction: Both intercept target acquisition and clear retained targets, so this is the closest comparator. TwilightCloak continuously derives player qualification from current light/inventory enabled state and has no timer/HP recovery phase. Vallumraptor owns a finite SynchedEntityData lease entered by tame+lowHP+live threat, independently requests faster recovery, clears specific threat revenge on entry, and can renew at expiry without separate cooldown. Its numeric lease, flee timer and local fade have distinct cleanup boundaries. This is proposed as one phase/lease family, not another generic target event or changed species.

MindTrick clears the controlled actor target before potion admission and retains target-null while potion active, with attack-attempt removal. Vallumraptor is the protected target, owns its health-qualified recurring hide lease, and blocks other actors acquiring it; it does not consume the lease on an attack attempt or turn off its own melee predicate.

Wight is a successful-teleport-qualified hide state with final hurt immunity, targetability and rendering gates. Vallumraptor is health/threat-qualified AI-target refusal with an independently interpolated partial body fade and no hiding hurt override in its complete subclass. Do not merge visual hide into universal damage refusal.

MysteriousPot consumes one hidden defense on first positive damage attempt then rearms under cooldown/navigation/LOS conditions. Vallumraptor does not consume hide in its hurt method or implement that hit budget; recurrence is lowHP/tame/live target after its timer ends, with ongoing AI acquisition refusal and recovery requests.

TigersEye rewrites another actor goal structure permanently, persists a marker and sends change-qualified success feedback. Vallumraptor does no such permanent goal rewrite or saved hide marker; its own countdown drives temporary protection and fade even though individual target cancellation has no dedicated result cue.

CalmingEssence depends on offhand/resource/cooldown, consumes on combat and scans anger/target types periodically. Vallumraptor uses its own low-health recurring lease and per-Mob current-target clearing, without offhand budget or combat revocation; initial threat revenge clearing differs from later target-only sweeps.

full_chain_observation: Fixed real entity registry creates Vallumraptor, attribute subscriber binds its attributes, ClientProxy binds VallumraptorRenderer, and complete mod constructor registers entity registry and CommonEvents on event bus. Registry/proxy reads are bounded binding declarations rather than claimed full containing initializers.

Complete native subclass defines HIDING_FOR sync integer default0, local hideProgress/prevHideProgress, and local fleeTicks/fleeFromPosition. In tick, after super.tick, hideProgress moves +1 toward20 while hideFor>0 and -1 toward0 after <=0. Health recovery requests heal2 on entity tick modulo15 while hiding versus100 otherwise, provided below max; this has no surrounding server-only guard.

Server-only block decrements positive hideFor by1 and positive relaxed timer; fleeTicks decrements in another server-only block. Later tick code, outside those explicit guards, examines its own current target: nonnull/alive/notcreativePlayer. If tame, health<max*.45 and hideFor<=0, chooses80..119, writes hideFor, fleeFromPosition=target position and fleeTicks=same i. If that current threat is Mob, requests setTarget(null), setLastHurtByMob(null) and setLastHurtMob(null).

Fresh hiding is not directly qualified by current hurt success. Its entire trigger is native tick state, and because countdown decrement precedes the trigger, expiration may immediately re-enter if lowHP/tame/threat still qualify. There is no separate hide-rearm cooldown or attack-attempt lease consumption in this complete subclass.

Complete CommonEvents.livingFindTarget cancels LivingChangeTarget when the new target is this class with hideFor>0, first requesting mob.setTarget(null). Complete livingTick also server-clears a Mob current target when it is a hiding Vallumraptor. The recurring sweep only clears target; the broader revenge/lastHurt clearing belongs to the selected threat at entry, not every observer.

Registered embedded FleeGoal requires positive fleeTicks and nonnull flee origin; tick sets running and navigates away only when current navigation is done, with hide-dependent search span4 versus8. stop nulls fleeFromPosition and sets running false; it does not clear hideFor or explicitly stop navigation. The hide countdown, flee timer, goal lifecycle and graphic progress are separate state lifetimes.

Complete own NBT methods save/load Elder, RelaxedTime and JustLootedChest while delegating super. There are no own HIDING_FOR/fleeTicks/flee origin/hideProgress keys; no durable hide lease/reload restoration is asserted. Natural expiry lets numeric hide reach0; visual progress fades independently and can still be positive after the target refusal condition ends.

Complete renderer.scale sets model alpha to1-.9*interpolatedHideProgress, nominally .1 at full progress rather than invisible. getRenderType uses hideProgress(1)>0 to force entityTranslucent; actual model setter and complete renderToBuffer multiply alphaIn by stored alpha. This graphic gate is not the integer hideFor>0 admission gate. Held ItemLayer renders its item without passing that model alpha or testing hideFor, so matching held-object fade is not established.

Complete own melee goal has no hideFor check in canUse/checkAndDealDamage; canUse instead checks live target, not dancing, not creativePlayer, and outbound damage still depends on LOS/range. Higher-priority FleeGoal uses MOVE and may affect scheduling, so this is not a claim attacks always run during hiding. Neither graphical fade nor target-event cancellation proves damage immunity or universal AI/control refusal.

No custom per-refusal text, reason packet, per-attempt flash or rejection sound occurs in the read target refusal listeners. Body alpha is state presentation. Existing generic eating/ambient/attack sounds and entity event45 are not refusal acknowledgments.
distinctness_argument: Propose only one complete health/threat-triggered renewable AI-target refusal lease with own recovery/flee state and independently lagged partial body fade. Distinction must stand on that whole lifecycle against the six prior decisions, not on Vallumraptor identity, threshold constants, two listeners, two clocks, textures or alpha math. Independent reviewer may reject as insufficiently distinct; no credit is applied here.
application_to_boss_immune: For Dynasty, distinguish authoritative eligibility lifetime from interpolated presentation and actual rejected operation. A state fade or faster heal request is not a per-attempt refusal result; a countdown may rearm immediately and must not silently extend stale feedback. Preserve exact actor/target scope and define interruption/reload policy. This is research only, not a proposed new dinosaur/stealth feature or gray text for ordinary constitution.
limitations: No explicit server-only guard surrounds the lowHP hide trigger or modulo recovery block, whereas countdown and retained-target sweep are server guarded. Do not claim random local trigger states converge or that all mutation is server-authoritative.

Forge LivingChangeTarget dispatch/arbitration, recursive setTarget(null) handling, other event listeners, native SynchedEntityData transport and Mob target memory/brain alternatives were not expanded or run. Only actual shown cancellation/clear calls are proved; no all-Boss/global-control guarantee.

Heal requests may be capped or canceled by the separately registered radiation heal listener and other rules. LowHP threshold can cease qualifying after recovery, but successful healing and an exact number of hidden intervals are not proved.

FleeGoal inherits default scheduling/continuation behavior not newly expanded. Stop does not explicitly stop navigation, and no geometry/pathfinding success is guaranteed. Own melee has no hide guard, but higher-priority MOVE goal matters.

Base Dinosaur class read only44..70 for identity/initialization; no claim of full inherited hurt/travel/effect policy. Complete subclass has no hide-specific hurt override, which is narrower than proving no other layer protects it.

Model read only alpha declaration and two complete alpha-consuming methods; no whole634line model, textures, animation design, pixels, occlusion, sound or render-backend acceptance. Transparent body retains nominal10percent opacity; no claim of total invisibility.
